== Trivia ==
*'''Nene''''s name is a reference to the term "Non", commonly used in the community to refer to new players. 
**They also appear to be wearing {{Item|Lapis Armor}}, a popular early-game armor set among new players.
**The internal ID and dialogue may suggest this is also a reference to the nostalgia of the early days of SkyBlock, before [[Fishing]] was added.
